title: Cloudflare Free
description: Open the Cloudflare dashboard, confirm the free plan, and locate Workers, R2 and Queues without exposing account details.

steps.title: Open Cloudflare Dashboard
steps.body: Open the dashboard. If you are already signed in, continue. Otherwise complete the normal Cloudflare sign-in or account-creation flow yourself.
steps.humanGate: Login, account creation, CAPTCHA, passkey/MFA, terms and any billing decision require your confirmation.

success.successMessage: A signed-in Cloudflare surface appears to be visible.

steps.title: Find Workers & Pages
steps.body: Use Find on page. CTRL searches visible controls and highlights the closest match instead of making you hunt through the navigation.

steps.title: Confirm the free path
steps.body: Stay on the free plan unless you intentionally choose otherwise. If Cloudflare presents a paid plan, card requirement, or trial conversion, stop before accepting it.
steps.humanGate: CTRL will not accept billing, paid upgrades, trials or final purchase controls for you.

steps.title: Find R2
steps.body: Locate R2 in the dashboard. This step only finds the control; it does not create buckets or accept billing-sensitive terms.

steps.title: Find Queues
steps.body: Locate Queues if it is available in your account. Use event-driven queues where appropriate rather than unnecessary polling.
